tasks.short: Prepare language and literature syllabi, assignments and handouts

steps.what: Set the actual course outcomes, student language level, lesson purpose and requirements for the syllabus, assignment or handout
inputs: actual programme/course requirements
actual student level and planned lesson topic
outputs: teacher's material brief and learning requirements

steps.what: Select and read the actual literary passages, language examples or signed-language references needed for the material
inputs: teacher's material brief and learning requirements
actual permitted texts and language references
outputs: teacher-selected source material and interpretation limits

steps.what: Write and check the actual syllabus, homework assignment or handout, including instructions, language examples and source attribution
inputs: teacher's material brief and learning requirements
teacher-selected source material and interpretation limits
actual timetable and submission requirements where applicable

loop.purpose: Draft bounded written course instructions and examples from the teacher's brief
loop.input: actual material brief, supplied source excerpts and exact course requirements
loop.output: suggested written material with source-linked passages and explicit missing fields
loop.check: teacher checks target-language correctness, level, literary claims, task clarity, attribution and all dates
loop.stop: unsupported source claim, uncertain language usage or a signed-language demonstration requires manual authoring
loop.why_not_simpler: fixed document fields cannot write level-appropriate exercises and explanations

steps.what: Save the completed checked material in the existing course workspace
inputs: complete checked language/literature course material

tasks.design: Use existing course templates in {DOCS} and {LMS} first, with bounded drafting of written instructions and exercises from the teacher's brief and actual supplied texts. The teacher checks language, interpretation and assignment fit before saving the material; signed-language demonstration content stays teacher-authored.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning actual course requirements and source passages into clear level-appropriate material requires repeated drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bounded drafting can suggest written exercises while fixed fields remain native templates.
tasks.still_hard: Idiomatic usage, cultural context and literary interpretation are not established by fluent wording.
tasks.human_edge: Choose authentic material and language work suited to the students' development.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for source rights and approved material processing

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded written-material drafting can assist language teaching when teachers verify correctness, source interpretation and learner level.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured. OTHER means literary/library and language-reference resources.
The teacher produces the actual brief in s1 and selects permitted source texts in s2. Dates and requirements come from existing course records; missing facts remain blank/manual.
Drafting is limited to written materials, not generated signed-language performance. All substantive checking and correction remain in s3.
Gross provisional saving 16.25 minus 2 hours of source packaging and drafting-rule upkeep gives 14.25 net. Existing equivalent support removes the corresponding gain.
The same-system save is fully retained; no automatic publication or student message is proposed.
unknowns: Current drafting support and language-specific correction effort
research_questions: Does assistance reduce total preparation time for actual assignments after language and interpretation checking?

already_counted.description: Correct and check the complete written teaching material

incremental.description: Package permitted source material and maintain/test language-specific drafting instructions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 14.25%; difficult language correction or signed-language material can remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain attendance, grades and required student records

steps.what: Observe and enter actual student attendance for the class session
inputs: actual students present and class session
existing enrolled-student roster
outputs: actual attendance entries for the identified class session

steps.what: Capture actual already-awarded grades and other required record facts once in the LMS against the correct students and assessments
inputs: teacher's actual awarded grades and required record facts
existing student and assessment identifiers

steps.what: Map the actual LMS attendance and authorised result export to fixed registry fields, stage the exact proposed update batch and reject missing or duplicate identities
inputs: actual attendance entries for the identified class session
completed student-grade and required-record entries
institution-approved registry field mapping and actual source versions
outputs: proposed registry batch with source IDs, versions and rejected rows

steps.what: Check the actual attendance, grade and proposed registry records for missing entries, identity errors, rejected rows, required fields, destination and correct configured totals
inputs: actual attendance entries for the identified class session
completed student-grade and required-record entries
actual course record and weighting rules
proposed registry batch with source IDs, versions and rejected rows

steps.what: Commit the exact checked student-record import batch to the intended student registry revision
inputs: complete checked student-record batch

tasks.design: Configure native roster/assessment fields in {LMS} and a fixed-field result import into {OTHER}, the student registry, where approved grades are currently entered twice. The explicit import-preparation step creates a proposed registry batch; the teacher supplies real facts, resolves rejected rows and checks the final batch before its separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Required-field and total checking can be repeated manually even inside a course system.
tasks.enabler_now: Native gradebook validation and configured course formulas can highlight missing or inconsistent entries.
tasks.still_hard: A valid field can still belong to the wrong student or contain a mistaken actual mark.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm the recorded facts and resolve discrepancies against the real class and assessment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for student-record access and approved record configuration

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course-record validation and gradebook formulas can reduce repeated field/total checking without deciding attendance or grades.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured. Actual attendance observation is fully retained, and grading itself is not counted again in record maintenance.
Existing enrolment administration supplies student/session identifiers; the teacher produces attendance in s1 and supplies actual awarded marks/required facts in s2.
Course owners supply weights and required fields. Missing facts or mismatched identities require manual correction; no model infers attendance or achievement.

Shares 35/12/28/24/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort, independent of the prompt prior. Native capture reuse saves 0.6, replaced duplicate registry entry saves 28 and native field-check presentation saves 4.8, for gross 33.4. Two hours of mapping/validation upkeep leaves 31.4 net. Existing equivalent validation/import removes the corresponding gain.

Registry import requires actual student/course/assessment IDs, authorised result and source version produced in s1/s2; the institution supplies approved mappings. Missing keys or unsupported fields stop for manual handling in s3. The import replaces actual double entry, not initial attendance capture or grade decisions.

The final import commit is negligible and fully retained; no saving is attributed to its runtime. The gain is removal of second-system re-keying. No student send is promised. Changes after s3 invalidate the gate.
unknowns: Existing gradebook checks and actual record requirements
research_questions: Which manual record checks remain after native validation and formulas are credited to today's system?

already_counted.description: Enter actual facts and inspect/correct the full record batch

incremental.description: Maintain registry mappings, required-field checks and course weighting changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 31.4%; conditional on actual duplicate registry entry, with original capture, grade decisions and final checks retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate and grade language/literature class work, assignments and papers

steps.what: Open and read or view the actual student work together with the assignment and applicable rubric
inputs: actual student class work, assignments, papers or submitted signed-language work
actual assignment and rubric
outputs: teacher-read student work in its assessment context

steps.what: Evaluate the student's actual language performance or literary argument against the rubric and determine the grade
inputs: teacher-read student work in its assessment context
actual rubric and assessment expectations
outputs: teacher's actual evaluation, grade and feedback points

steps.what: Enter the actual rubric marks and feedback, and check that the final grade and comments reflect the student's work
inputs: teacher's actual evaluation, grade and feedback points
actual student work and teacher-authored reusable comments where applicable
outputs: complete checked individual grade and feedback version

steps.what: Save the completed checked individual assessment in the existing course system
inputs: complete checked individual grade and feedback version

tasks.design: Configure a native work/rubric view and teacher-authored comment bank in {LMS}. The teacher evaluates language performance and literary interpretation, selects and edits only applicable comments, then checks the exact grade and feedback before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Moving between work, rubric and repeated comment wording can interrupt assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rubric views and existing authored comment banks can reduce navigation and repeated typing.
tasks.still_hard: Context, idiomatic meaning, signed performance and original literary arguments require teacher evaluation.
tasks.human_edge: Assess what the student demonstrates rather than count surface errors.

ambition.what: No automated grading or extra marking volume assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for assessment permissions and approved rubric configuration

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native rubric views and teacher-authored comment banks can reduce assessment navigation and repeated typing while grades remain teacher decisions.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured. Only navigation and literal comment reuse change; evaluation and grade determination remain fully retained.
Students produce the actual work; the course owner supplies the rubric; the teacher produces the evaluation in s2 and checks applicable comment wording in s3.
No model scores work or infers proficiency. New comment-bank maintenance is charged below; existing equivalent views/banks remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 3.4 minus 0.5 hour of comment/rubric upkeep gives 2.9 net. The final save is fully retained and publication to students is not automated.
Deduplicate the actual grade-entry action against task 6337 when rolling up record maintenance.
unknowns: Existing rubric views and reusable feedback coverage
research_questions: Which real comments repeat verbatim often enough for native reuse after checking applicability?

already_counted.description: Read the work and enter/check individual marks and feedback

incremental.description: Maintain teacher-authored comments and rubric-view configuration

approvals.approved_version: complete checked individual grade and feedback version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.9%; substantive reading/evaluation and final checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Initiate and moderate language/literature classroom discussions

steps.what: Introduce the actual passage, language question or signed-language prompt and invite students' initial contributions
inputs: actual lesson passage or discussion prompt
students present in the class
outputs: actual discussion opening and initial student contributions

steps.what: Facilitate and moderate the actual spoken or signed exchange, probe interpretations and help students participate and respond
inputs: actual discussion opening and initial student contributions
students' actual subsequent language and interpretations
outputs: actual moderated classroom discussion and explanation

tasks.design: Keep responsive spoken or signed classroom discussion with the teacher. Initiation and moderation remain explicit human work, with no new transcript, participation scoring or automatic discussion summary.
tasks.previous_blocker: The next useful intervention depends on actual student contributions.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported change removes live discussion work in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Participation, language confidence and ambiguous interpretations require contextual response.
tasks.human_edge: Notice meaning and misunderstanding and help students develop their own contributions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live spoken or signed discussion moderation depends on actual student contributions and responsive teaching.

assumptions: Shares are illustrative and unmeasured; the existing lesson passage/prompt is an input, not a fabricated preparation baseline.
The statement requires live discussion and establishes no separate record write, report or send. Actual material preparation is addressed in task 6335.
No structured student participation or emotion data is assumed. All work remains, gross/net saving are zero and there is no new upkeep.
unknowns: Actual class format and language modality
research_questions: Does observed discussion contain a distinct actual written follow-up task requiring its own design?

incremental.description: No new system or discussion process proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported change to live discussion initiation, facilitation or moderation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Configure native record and rubric checks
role.ambitious_version: Reduce bounded material drafting and record handling while preserving language evaluation, literary judgment and responsive classroom discussion.

job.title: Foreign Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
